snippet.title: Steam |『Shikhondo: Blue Pieta』Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#cfk #Steam #Shikhondo #BluePieta

『Shikhondo: Blue Pieta』, act 2 of Shikhondo,
unfolds atop a new stage on May 18, 2026!
Complete the Pietà of struggle that burns blue with its raging barrage!

● Steam Store
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4445060/

《 CHARACTERS 》
● Grim Reaper (Voiced by Ikumi Hasegawa) 
An ordinary college student buried under busy days, moving between the ordinary and extraordinary in her duties as a Death's emissary trainee.

● Vampire hunter (Voiced by Yoshino Aoyama) 
Heir to a family of wizards with a long history.
As payment for the powerful magic she inherited from her predecessors, time has stopped for her, and her body shows no sign of aging for all time.
